description: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks at intervals of 2, ranging from 2 to 8, though data points extend from x=1 to x=9. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, ranging from 33.5 to 36.5. The plot contains a solid black line without markers representing "DPR w/o query," which remains constant at approximately 34.4 across the x-axis. The "DPR w/ gold" method is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it begins below the visible y-axis range for x-values 1 through 3, appears at approximately 33.5 at x=4, and rises steadily to end at roughly 36.2 at x=9. The "DPR w/ top-1" method is depicted by a solid green line with circular markers, starting below the visible y-axis range at x=1, jumping to 34.9 at x=2, and climbing steeply to approximately 37.0 at x=9. An associated dashed green line without markers shows a steady linear increase from roughly 34.7 at x=1 to 35.9 at x=9. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" method is represented by a solid purple line with circular markers, starting at 34.8 at x=1, rising to 35.4 at x=3, dipping slightly to 35.3 at x=4, and then increasing to 36.0 at x=9. A corresponding dashed purple line without markers increases linearly from 34.9 at x=1 to 36.2 at x=9. The "DPR w/ random" method is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, increasing steadily from 34.8 at x=1 to 36.5 at x=9, accompanied by a dashed blue line without markers that rises linearly from 35.2 at x=1 to 36.4 at x=9. Finally, the "DPR w/ curriculum" method is illustrated by a solid red line with circular markers, starting at 35.2 at x=1 and rising to 36.9 at x=9, with an associated dashed red line without markers increasing linearly from 35.6 at x=1 to 36.8 at x=9.
